Every JAL "Courier" pilot
at least a million miler!
Aboard Douglas' newest long-range DC-6Bs, you're
flown by the most seasoned American trans Pacific
flight crews. Every JAL pilot has logged at least a
million miles of transoceanic flying-most of them
over two million.
"COURIER" CARGO
2,500 HP PRATT & WHITNEY ENGINES
And much of this unsurpassed experience has been
flown over the very route of the "Pacific Courier."
These pilots, all CAA-licensed Americans, have al-
ready totalled over 1,500 trans Pacific crossings.
World's most efficient maintenance
Before every take-off and after every landing, JAL's
DC-6B "Couriers" are thoroughly checked by skilled
aircraft experts. And at regular scheduled inter-
vals, every "Courier" is rigorously tested by United
Air Lines engineers at UAL's huge San Francisco
Maintenance Base. Here Japan Air Lines' DC-6Bs
get the world's most modern, efficient maintenance.
